items.question: How does knowledge become manifest for one who takes refuge in yoga?
premises: knowledge becomes manifest through fitting means
the yogin takes refuge in yoga
identification follows union
items.inference: Manifest knowledge arises when the yogin becomes united and identified with that reality.
items.plain_english: Knowledge becomes manifest in the fitting way; the yogin who takes refuge in yoga becomes united and attains identification with that reality.

items.question: What depends on guru initiation mantra and scripture?
premises: all states depend on guru initiation
this applies to wicked beings
past present and future beings are included
items.inference: The condition of all beings, especially the wicked, depends on guru initiation, mantra, and scripture.
items.plain_english: Then all states depend on guru initiation, mantra, and scripture, especially for wicked beings among past, present, and future.

items.question: For whom should actions be purified?
premises: purification of actions is required
it is not for one desiring enjoyment
good souls are distinguished from worldly enjoyers
items.inference: Purification of actions is for good souls, not for those seeking worldly enjoyment like a child.
items.plain_english: Purification of actions should be done; it is not for one desiring enjoyment, while good souls are distinguished from those seeking worldly pleasures like kingdom and heaven.

items.question: What initiation is performed for one desiring transcendent enjoyment?
premises: transcendent enjoyment is abandoned
desire remains for his enjoyment
material initiation is performed with offerings
items.inference: For one desiring enjoyment, even auspicious material initiation with ghee and sesame is performed there.
items.plain_english: Having abandoned transcendent enjoyment, one desiring his enjoyment performs there a material initiation with ghee, sesame, and similar offerings, even in auspicious matters.

items.question: How does action become pure in knowledge-filled initiation?
premises: the teacher offers saying I purify his action
in knowledge-filled initiation purity occurs
purity arises by union
items.inference: In knowledge-filled initiation, action becomes pure by union, while the best teacher offers with the intention of purification.
items.plain_english: The best teacher should offer, saying 'I purify his action'; but in knowledge-filled initiation, that becomes pure by union.

items.question: When do inauspicious actions become pure?
premises: the guru rooted in self-awareness acts by force
destruction of that occurs
when inauspicious actions become pure then auspiciousness follows
items.inference: By the guru's forceful power rooted in self-awareness, destruction occurs; when inauspicious actions become pure, then auspiciousness follows.
items.plain_english: By the force of the guru rooted in self-awareness, destruction occurs; when his inauspicious actions become pure, then auspiciousness follows.

items.question: What arises in the middle of the path by relying on one's gradation?
premises: reliance on one's own gradation occurs in the path
production arises there
completion of enjoyment of fruits obtained by auspicious ripening sequence follows
items.inference: By relying on one's own gradation in the path, production arises, leading to completion of enjoyment of fruits obtained by auspicious ripening sequence.
items.plain_english: By relying on one's own gradation in the path, this production arises, from the completion of enjoyment of fruits obtained by auspicious ripening sequence.

items.question: What happens when future action is destroyed?
premises: this one is placed there
future action is destroyed
future beings differ between first body and other body
items.inference: When future action is destroyed, this placed one remains there, affecting future beings who differ between first body and other body.
items.plain_english: Where this one is placed and stands, when future action is destroyed, it concerns future beings differing between the first body and another body.

items.question: What happens when the inauspicious part is purified?
premises: purification of inauspicious part occurs
there is no decrease of enjoyment itself
the enjoyer constantly enjoys from maya's abode to the end
items.inference: When the inauspicious part is purified, enjoyment itself does not decrease; the enjoyer constantly enjoys from the abode of maya to the end.
items.plain_english: When the inauspicious part is purified, there is no decrease of enjoyment itself; this enjoyer constantly enjoys from the abode of maya to the end.

items.question: Does anything give painful fruit in the path beginning with body?
premises: nothing gives painful fruit
even in the path beginning with body
then in maya's abode all pleasant enjoyments are enjoyed
items.inference: Nothing gives painful fruit even in the path beginning with body; then in maya's abode all pleasant enjoyments are enjoyed.
items.plain_english: Nothing gives painful fruit even in the path beginning with the body; then in the abode of maya all pleasant enjoyments are enjoyed.

items.question: How does dissolution occur in the partless and with-parts?
premises: dissolution goes in the partless and with-parts
it occurs by the force of union
this knowable was told at initiation time as of the guru
items.inference: Dissolution occurs in both partless and with-parts states by the force of union; this knowable was told at initiation time as from the guru.
items.plain_english: Dissolution goes in the partless and in the with-parts by the force of union; thus this knowable was told at the time of initiation, as from the guru.
